targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

WITH month_spend AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) AS spent FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)), days_elapsed AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE)::numeric AS days, EXTRACT(DAY FROM (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date)::numeric AS total_days) SELECT ROUND(month_spend.spent / days_elapsed.days * days_elapsed.total_days, 2) FROM month_spend, days_elapsed
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(filament_cost)::numeric, 2) AS filament, ROUND(SUM(electricity_cost)::numeric, 2) AS electricity FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom()

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, 'Electricity' AS type, ROUND(SUM(electricity_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost FROM print_jobs WHERE electricity_cost > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, 'Filament' AS type, ROUND(SUM(filament_cost)::numeric, 2) AS cost FROM print_jobs WHERE filament_cost > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) AS daily_cost FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric OVER (ORDER BY DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth')), 2) AS cumulative_cost FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT filename, ROUND((COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric, 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(electricity_cost::numeric, 2) AS elec, ROUND(filament_cost::numeric, 2) AS fil, ROUND(actual_duration_seconds / 60.0) AS duration_min FROM print_jobs ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(electricity_cost, 0) + COALESCE(filament_cost, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(actual_duration_seconds) / 3600, 0), 2) AS cost_per_hour FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND actual_duration_seconds > 0
